title: The runstate maintenance fixture fails on this host at base, making the full runstate suite red regardless of any tick's work
body: TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo fails reproducibly at 6d581789 with changes stashed ('a plain git fetch in the armed repository started no maintenance; this fixture proves nothing'): the control that proves git auto-maintenance fires inside a fetch does not fire on this host, so every full (non -short) runstate run is red before any change. It is EndToEnd, so the per-tick gate is unaffected. This is the fixture the learnings say was filed four more times in gvc; reproduced again here on 2026-09-26.
